result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred insurance requirements: USD 1M/2M CGL, USD 2M E&O, conditional USD 5M cyber coverage, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, requiring every policy to remain in force for one year after the term exceeds the playbook and is not necessary to reach the preferred position. The amendment also creates two sections numbered 14.10; despite the margin comment stating that the following subsection will be renumbered, the rendered clause does not do so. The unrelated bankruptcy and integration provisions otherwise remain substantively unchanged.
